DONE

The Clojure server is now ported to Zig 0.16. A clean build passes all 4 cases with `node check.mjs`, and the Zig unit tests pass (7 of 7). It uses only the standard library, so `build.sh` has nothing to fetch. It does a ReleaseFast build and copies the binary to `./app`.

On a random port, I also checked by hand:
- **Large values:** a 1 MiB random binary value comes back byte-for-byte identical, and empty values work.
- **Concurrency:** 200 parallel PUTs and 200 parallel GETs all succeed.
